# ProposalKit India

ProposalKit India is a free browser-based proposal and GST invoice generator for Indian freelancers and small agencies.

- Home: https://proposalkit.in/
- Proposal generator: https://proposalkit.in/proposal
- GST invoice generator: https://proposalkit.in/invoice
- Templates: https://proposalkit.in/templates
- Privacy: https://proposalkit.in/privacy
- Terms: https://proposalkit.in/terms

The app does not require sign-in. Document data and branding are stored in the browser. AI proposal drafting is optional; when used, proposal inputs are sent to the configured AI provider through a server route.
